services.name: Geneseo Campground
services.desc: Our posted speed limit is 5 mph. Please take your time, and watch out for animals and other camp guests. Please avoid parking on the grass. We allow one vehicle per site. Please park your camper leaving enough room to park your vehicle in the site and on the gravel. If your tent site does not have a gravel pad, please park in the grassy infield directly across from your site. Visitors are welcome, but for everyone's safety we ask that they check in at the office to provide name, vehicle info and phone

services.name: 2022 Witches Night Out
services.desc: The campground hosts local musicians each Saturday evening in the summer to play a free concert for all campers. Come enjoy live music played by local singer/songwriters as the campground guests and staff gather around the campfire. Times and musicians vary each week, but our concerts are usually an hour long and wrap up by sundown. We offer paid gigs to any camper or musician who is interested in playing.
